import json, re
from pathlib import Path

def merge_jsonl(path):
    text = Path(path).read_text()
    lines = []
    for part in re.split(r'^<<<<<<< HEAD\n|^=======\n|^>>>>>>> origin/main\n', text, flags=re.M):
        for line in part.strip().splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if line and not line.startswith('<<<<') and not line.startswith('>>>>'):
                lines.append(line)
    # dedupe while preserving order after sort by ts
    seen = set()
    unique = []
    for line in sorted(lines, key=lambda l: json.loads(l).get('ts','')):
        if line not in seen:
            seen.add(line)
            unique.append(line)
    Path(path).write_text('\n'.join(unique) + ('\n' if unique else ''))
